# BrandPulse

> BrandPulse measures how often AI answers recommend a business compared with its competitors, shows the real AI answers as evidence, and fixes the gaps with done-for-you pages and re-checks. The current production audit engine uses Gemini with Google Search grounding.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.zerociate.com/): What BrandPulse does and the free AI visibility audit.
- [Done for you](https://www.zerociate.com/sprint): We find the buyer questions where AI names competitors instead of you, then write, publish and re-check the pages that change the answer.
- [Methodology](https://www.zerociate.com/methodology): How BrandPulse generates buyer questions, observes answer engines, diagnoses evidence gaps, and what it cannot know.
- [About](https://www.zerociate.com/about): What BrandPulse is, who it is for, and what it never does.

## What We Do

BrandPulse helps businesses:
- Audit observed visibility in Gemini answers grounded with Google Search
- Compare observed mentions, recommendations, citations, and competitor presence
- Review the captured answers and source evidence behind each audit
- Turn observed gaps into a prioritized action plan
